run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: OpenTelemetry Demo Astronomy Shop
Namespace: astronomy-shop

An online shopping platform built with a microservices architecture, showcasing OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing across services.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The recommendations path is broken for the frontend. From ~00:16:39 UTC the frontend's gRPC client records '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ETIMEDOUT 10.96.227.85:8080', where 10.96.227.85 is the ClusterIP of Service recommendation:8080; its /api/recommendations requests end as HTTP 500 after 34-76 s, frontend-proxy turns them into 504 after ~15 s, and the load-generator records the failed GETs. In the 5 minutes ending 00:18:22 frontend 'GET /api/recommendations' averaged 16405 ms while the frontend's other routes stayed at ~5-53 ms, and frontend-proxy/load-generator were the only services with ERROR spans in the last 10 minutes. The request never reaches the application: pod recommendation-68f45757cd-89kmr is Running and Ready with 0 restarts, its labels match the Service selector, its pod IP 10.244.234.134:8080 is listed in the Service Endpoints, there are no networking.k8s.io NetworkPolicy or ResourceQuota objects in the cluster, and the container logged a clean 'Recommendation service started, listening on port 8080' at 00:16:35 with nothing after it; recommendation server spans stop at 00:16:12 and its span rate is 0 in the last two minutes. The same frontend pod still serves other dependencies over their ClusterIPs in the same minutes (/api/data 200 in ~8-10 ms with ad GetAds rpc.grpc.status_code=0 at 00:18:21), so general DNS/pod networking on the frontend is not broken. The degradation began 4 s after the recommendation Deployment's config-only revision 3 pod (nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=sregym-worker, unchanged demo:2.2.0-recommendation image) and 11 s after the frontend Deployment's config-only revision 2 pod (nodeSelector sregym-worker2, unchanged image), with the previous pods stopped by the rollout. A TCP connect to the recommendation ClusterIP timing out rather than being refused, with a Ready destination that never sees the request, indicates traffic is being dropped on the network path; the object that applies that drop (a Calico-level policy or equivalent) is not readable with the available tools, so the exact mechanism remains unresolved and no fault-injection flag is switched on (all flagd flags defaultVariant 'off') and Kafka is healthy with zero accounting consumer lag.

claims.text: Frontend span oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=14 and grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ETIMEDOUT 10.96.227.85:8080 (2026-11-24T00:18:51.808Z)', and its parents 'executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations' and 'GET /api/recommendations' are ERROR with http.status_code 500 after up to 76.1 s in 5 sampled traces between 00:17:35 and 00:18:22.

Service recommendation in namespace astronomy-shop is ClusterIP 10.96.227.85 with port 8080 to targetPort 8080 and selector opentelemetry.io/name=recommendation, so the address in the frontend's connect timeout is the recommendation Service ClusterIP.

The user-visible failures are on the recommendations path: sampled traces show frontend-proxy 'GET' spans failing with http.status_code=504/otel.status_code=ERROR after ~15.002 s paired with load-generator 'GET' 504 spans, and increase over the 10 minutes ending 00:18:22 gives 7.77 frontend-proxy and 6.66 load-generator error spans as the only error-making services in that window.

In the 5 minutes ending 00:18:22 frontend 'GET /api/recommendations' averaged 16405 ms while GET /, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, GET /api/products/[productId]/index and POST /api/checkout averaged ~5-53 ms.

Recommendation traces exist only up to 00:16:12, and the recommendation span rate (increase over 1 minute of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="recommendation"}) is 18.255 at step 00:17:22 and 0 at step 00:18:22.

Pod recommendation-68f45757cd-89kmr is Running and Ready with 0 restarts and no readiness/liveness probe, carries labels app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendation and opentelemetry.io/name=recommendation, has podIP 10.244.234.134 on node sregym-worker, and its container log contains only 'Recommendation service started, listening on port 8080' at 00:16:35.944 with no later lines.

The recommendation Service Endpoints list address 10.244.234.134:8080 targeting pod recommendation-68f45757cd-89kmr, that pod IP is in the sregym-worker pod range 10.244.234.0/24, and the cluster has 0 networking.k8s.io NetworkPolicy objects and 0 ResourceQuota objects.

The same frontend pod still serves other dependencies: at 00:18:21-00:18:22 traces show GET /api/data returning 200 in 8.2-10.4 ms with frontend oteldemo.AdService/GetAds rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and frontend-proxy GET 200.

Both rollouts changed configuration only: Deployment frontend revision 2 created ReplicaSet frontend-6765c5b7c8 at 00:16:28 whose pod template adds nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=sregym-worker2 (revision 1 had none), and Deployment recommendation reached revision 2 at 00:15:55 and revision 3 at 00:16:33 with nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=sregym-worker; all revisions carry the identical demo:2.2.0-frontend and demo:2.2.0-recommendation images and identical container specs.

Previous pods were stopped by the rollout rather than crashing: events show 'Stopping container frontend' on frontend-6859c775df-x8md4 at 00:16:29 and 'Stopping container recommendation' on recommendation-5bb649dccb-dc5hh at 00:15:56 and recommendation-6b9dd6f6fc-8x42t at 00:16:34, and no astronomy-shop pod shows a restart or crash/OOM reason.

No fault-injection feature flag is on: every flag in ConfigMap flagd-config, including kafkaQueueProblems, recommendationCacheFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, adHighCpu, imageSlowLoad and emailMemoryLeak, has defaultVariant 'off'.
Kafka is healthy and the accounting consumer group has zero lag on topic orders (committed_offset 22 = end_offset 22), with 1 broker, 51 partitions, 0 under-replicated and 0 offline partitions.

Traffic from the frontend pod to the recommendation service is being silently dropped: the gRPC connect to 10.96.227.85:8080 ends in ETIMEDOUT (a drop signature, not the ECONNREFUSED of a closed port or unready endpoint), the recommendation pod is Ready with correct Endpoints, and it never receives the call (no server spans, no log lines after startup). A Calico-level policy or equivalent network fault scoped to the recommendation or frontend pod would fit this evidence.

The recommendation Deployment is the faulty component in this incident: its config-only revision 3 pod (created 00:16:33 on sregym-worker) is the dependency the frontend can no longer reach, the first failing recommendation call at 00:16:39 follows its start at 00:16:35 by 4 seconds, and the service had answered ListRecommendations in 2.9-3.8 ms before the rollout.

Rejected: the recommendation application itself failing or being slow. Before the rollout its server spans completed ListRecommendations in 2.9-3.8 ms with rpc.grpc.status_code=0, the new container logged a successful start on port 8080, and a non-listening or erroring application would yield connection refused or gRPC server statuses instead of a TCP connect timeout with zero server spans.

Rejected: fault flags or Kafka problems as the cause. All flagd flags are off and the accounting consumer group has zero lag with a fully replicated Kafka cluster, so neither kafkaQueueProblems nor any other injected flag explains the recommendations outage.

The frontend pod is not generally broken: it answers GET /api/data and side ad calls with 200 in 8-10 ms during the same minutes, holds 0 restarts, and logged 'Ready in 113ms' at 00:16:30, so a whole-pod failure or cold start does not explain the 15 s recommendation timeouts.

Destination-side Kubernetes state shows no misconfiguration: the recommendation pod's labels match the Service selector, the Endpoints list 10.244.234.134:8080, that IP is inside the sregym-worker pod range, and there are no NetworkPolicy or ResourceQuota objects, so the drop is not explained by a selector mismatch, missing endpoint or quota.

Inspect the Calico policy custom resources (NetworkPolicy/GlobalNetworkPolicy/NetworkSet objects of crd.projectcalico.org) that select the recommendation pod 10.244.234.134 or the frontend pod, since the built-in networking.k8s.io NetworkPolicy kind returned no objects.

Test TCP reachability to 10.244.234.134:8080 and to the recommendation ClusterIP 10.96.227.85:8080 from a pod on sregym-worker2 and from a pod on another node, and check kube-proxy rule sync on sregym-worker2, to separate a destination-specific drop from a service-path problem.

Read the frontend pod's log lines written after 00:18:22 (133 lines fell outside the authorized window) together with the recommendation pod's log, to capture the retry/timeout sequence and confirm whether recommendation traffic recovers.

gaps: The object that drops traffic to the recommendation pod is not observable: Calico policy CRDs exist (networkpolicies.crd.projectcalico.org, globalnetworkpolicies.crd.projectcalico.org, networksets.crd.projectcalico.org) but their custom resources cannot be listed with the available resource kinds, and the built-in networking.k8s.io NetworkPolicy query returned 0 objects.

No change_history integration is configured, so it cannot be established who or what applied the config-only frontend revision 2 (00:16:28) and recommendation revisions 2/3 (00:15:55, 00:16:33), nor whether a network fault was introduced around 00:16:35.
kube-proxy logging on sregym-worker2 (pod kube-proxy-k9wsf) returned no lines inside the window (query status no_data), so iptables/IPVS rule-sync state on the frontend's node is unchecked.
Only the frontend calls the recommendation service, so whether the timeout is specific to the frontend pod or affects every client of the recommendation pod is unknown.

No apiserver log or container stdout was available for the frontend pod after 00:18:22 (133 lines outside the window), and the recommendation pod wrote no request-level logs, so the application side of the timeout cannot be read from logs.
The long accounting 'order-consumed' spans seen at 00:18:06 (2.47 s and 25.58 s) were not resolved further; Kafka lag is 0, so they are not tied to this incident.
Whether the recommendation service resumes serving after the incident window cannot be determined from the sampled data.
next_steps: Inspect Calico NetworkPolicy/GlobalNetworkPolicy/NetworkSet custom resources selecting the recommendation and frontend pods.
Run a TCP connectivity test to 10.244.234.134:8080 and 10.96.227.85:8080 from pods on sregym-worker2 and on another node.
Review kube-proxy rule-sync health and logs on sregym-worker2 and sregym-worker.
Re-check the frontend and recommendation logs and traces after 00:18:22 to confirm recovery or persistence.
